description.en: Control your Apple TV with Remote Two/3.

value.en:
The integration finds Apple TV devices on the network.

- Apple TV HD or Apple TV 4K is required.
- Enter the IP address of the Apple TV in the setup, or leave it empty to search the network.
- A PIN is shown on the TV during pairing.
- Set AirPlay access on the Apple TV to "Anyone on the Same Network".
- For voice control, turn on Siri on the Apple TV: Settings > General > Siri.
